goal: Generate an illustrated map representing the traditional central axis style of Beijing, suitable for cultural tourism brochures, WeChat header images, and exhibition backdrops.
style: Light color Forbidden City red and city brick gray in a watercolor hand-drawn style, on a beige watercolor paper base

title_section.title_text: Beijing time on the mid-axis line
title_section.subtitle: Walking imagination from Yongdingmen to Bell and Drum Tower.

geography_skeleton.rivers_or_lakes: The North Sea and the Central Sea reservoir-like water areas are lightly blue-gray tinted, with imprecise mapping
geography_skeleton.mountains: the western suburban Xiangshan and Jingshan suggested altitude contrast with simplified triangles
geography_skeleton.main_streets: Using a thick golden line running from south to north through Yongdingmen, Tiantan Bridge, Zhengyangmen, Tiananmen, Shenduomen, Di’anmen to Bell and Drum Tower.

landmarks.items: Yongdingmen Arrow Tower, Xiannongtan, Temple of Heaven's Hall of Prayer for Good Harvest, Qianmen Arrow Tower and Zhengyangmen, People's Hero Monument, Tiananmen and the Forbidden City’s Meridian Gate, a corner of the Hall of Supreme Harmony with a golden top, Jingshan Wanchun Pavilion overlooking the central axis, Di'anmen, Drum Tower and Bell Tower, distant view of Shichahai Yin Ding Bridge.

centerpiece: Slightly above the center of the image is an abstract aerial view from the perspective of the central axis convergence point of the Forbidden City and the Wanchun Pavilion on Jingshan, integrating the imagery of the golden roofs with the central yellow line on the ground.
edge_decorations: corner tower eaves and ridge beast silhouette in the upper left and right corners
A few strokes of glass tile as a scatter
Stone Blue seal with the inscription 'Central Axis Journey'
extras: Small text inscription: The central axis is the backbone of this city, where one can read the ups and downs of history in a day.

must_keep: The north-south axial direction is easily readable
The scale relationship between the Temple of Heaven and the Forbidden City is not exaggerated.
